sources.snippet: A complete end-to-end sentiment and emotion analysis project using classical ML models and an LSTM deep learning model, combined using majority voting. Includes a modular prediction engine and Streamlit-based web app for deployment.

sources.snippet: Learn how to process, classify, cluster, summarize, understand syntax, semantics and sentiment of text data with the power of Python! This repository contains code and datasets used in my book, "Text Analytics with Python" published by Apress/Springer.
